FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(GUTHRIE CORRIDOR EXPRESSWAY) (NO. 2) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister make the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection Of Tolls) (Guthrie Corridor Expressway) (No. 2) (Amendment)

Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 20 October 2022.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Guthrie Corridor Expressway) (No. 2) Order 2005 [P.U. (A) 298/2005], which is

referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)

by substituting for the words "31 May 2036" the words "31 May 2062".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedule:
